county_relationship.note: Counties derived from the county on each facility's source record. A ZIP can span several counties; HUD USPS crosswalk not yet configured.

top_violation_types.title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was no documentation of fire safety emergency drills, fire extinguisher checks, smoke detector checks, and carbon monoxide detector testing made available for review during the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone (26 TAC §745.621(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A caregiver, with direct access to children, was present without a background check eligibility.  The caregiver was sent home during the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §747.1501(c)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A bouncer with an infant in it was placed top of a couch.     Note:  Bouncer was placed on the floor during inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Minimum Qualifications for Substitute Caregiver (26 TAC §747.1209(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: CCR observed a household member assisting the provider in caring for the children, who does not meet the minimum qualifications required for an assistant caregiver.

top_violation_types.title: Initiate Background Checks as specified in Chapter 745 (26 TAC §747.207(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The provider did not submit initial background checks for household members.

top_violation_types.title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Self- Instructional up to 80% (26 TAC §747.1309(i))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregiver did not meet the requirements of obtaining at least 6 hours of annual training in a classroom or virtual classroom setting.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation and video, it was found that the caregiver did not demonstrate a high level of judgment or self-control.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the DFPS investigation, a child was disciplined by pinching their ear, which resulted in bruising.
